details: Bitcoin has demonstrated resilience by stabilizing above the $64,000 level. This stability is largely attributed to consistent spot Bitcoin ETF inflows, which recorded over $75 million for the past week. This sustained institutional demand, coupled with an improving U.S. regulatory outlook, is helping to counteract broader risk-off sentiment observed in traditional financial markets. Additionally, an increase in Bitcoin futures open interest further indicates a strengthening accumulation trend.
title: Bitcoin Holds Steady Above $64K Amid Persistent ETF Inflows

details: The broader cryptocurrency market is currently exhibiting renewed weakness, with most major digital assets struggling to maintain positive momentum this week. While Ethereum has shown relative stability, the overall demand strength seen in preceding weeks has diminished. Technical indicators point towards a period of market indecision and potential downside risk, especially if cryptocurrencies fail to break past crucial resistance levels.
title: Crypto Market Momentum Weakens, Technical Analysis Suggests Caution

details: Pi Network experienced a significant price surge of 10.5% within 24 hours, outperforming a generally flat crypto market. This rally is primarily fueled by speculative interest in anticipation of its upcoming Protocol v25 upgrade, scheduled for July 22, 2026. The upgrade is expected to introduce privacy-preserving smart contracts and support for zero-knowledge proofs, aiming to enhance the network's utility for enterprise and payment applications.
title: Pi Network Surges 10.5% Ahead of Major Protocol Upgrade
